error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: The interface hit an unexpected error. Your display was not changed.

display.title: Display
display.subtitle: Saturation up to 300%, digital vibrance and fine color tuning, monitor by monitor.
items: Saturation from 0 to 300% (100 is the game as it ships)
Brightness, contrast, gamma, temperature, shadows and highlights per monitor
Choose which monitors it applies to and identify each screen
Compare against the original image with a single button
Driver-level digital vibrance on NVIDIA and AMD

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Your looks, crosshairs, resolutions and profiles, stored on your PC.
items: Color looks, crosshairs, resolutions and profiles in one place
Search and filter by game
Share with a text code (over Discord or WhatsApp) and import a friend's
Everything stays on your PC: no account and no servers

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.subtitle: Stretched resolution, refresh rate and HDR, with automatic rollback.
items: Current mode of each monitor: resolution, Hz, scaling and HDR
4:3, 5:4 and 16:10 stretched presets computed for your monitor
Custom resolution builder
Countdown: if you don't confirm, it goes back on its own
Hotkey to switch between native and stretched resolution

monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.subtitle: What your monitor lets you adjust in hardware.
items: Details for each screen: model, GPU, HDR and scale
Hardware brightness and contrast (DDC/CI) on compatible monitors
Per-monitor gamma and warmth

customize.title: Customize
customize.subtitle: Make VRes look the way you like.
items: Interface themes
Background with your own image or GIF
Window opacity

crosshair.title: Crosshair
crosshair.subtitle: An overlay crosshair, drawn on the screen and not inside the game.
items: Transparent window that doesn't intercept clicks
Shape by parts, size, thickness, gap, outline, color and opacity
Crosshair from your own image
Presets, saved designs, history and share code
Option to hide it from recordings and streams

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.subtitle: Each game with its own setup, applied automatically when it opens.
items: Per-game profile: look, crosshair, resolution and tools
Detects Fortnite, VALORANT, CS2, Apex Legends, Rust and Rainbow Six Siege
When you leave the game, everything goes back to how it was
Add any other game in two clicks

enhancers.title: Dark Boost & Zoom
enhancers.subtitle: Tools to see better in specific moments.
items: Dark Boost: lifts the shadows while you hold a key
1.5× to 4× zoom while you hold a key or a mouse button
They pause on their own when you leave the game
Off by default: some games may consider them an advantage

more.title: More
more.subtitle: Language, updates and information about VRes.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: VRes checks GitHub for new versions. It's the only internet connection it makes.
updates.onlyInApp: Only available in the installed app.

safety.title: If something looks wrong
safety.description: When you close VRes, your display goes back to how it was. Starting in phase F1, the Ctrl + Alt + Shift + R shortcut resets it at any time, even with the window closed.

about.title: About
about.license: Free software under the GPL-3.0 license. No account and no telemetry.
